e.title: InsuranceQA (原始语料)
e.summary: 保险 QA 语料原始仓库（shuzi，465★，Feng 等 ASRU 2015）：保险领域首个开放 QA 语料
e.body:
InsuranceQA Corpus（shuzi/insuranceQA，465★）是论文《Applying Deep Learning to Answer Selection》（Feng/Bing Xiang 等，ASRU 2015）发布的原始语料仓库：从 Insurance Library 收集的问题与答案——**保险领域首个开放的 QA 语料**（12,888 训练/2,000 测试题，每题 500 个候选答案），答案选择（answer selection）研究的经典基准。对 RIAA：保险 QA 研究的基准源头——池中 [[insuranceqa-corpus]]（中文版 1065★）与 [[insurance-qa-en]]（英文镜像）的数据源；配 [[insqabench]]（中文保险 QA 评测）与 [[qa-deep-learning]]（CNN 论文代码）理解保险 NLP 起点。

**相关**：本语料的 HuggingFace 再包装（数据集形态）见 [[insurance-qa-en]]。

e.summary_en: Original InsuranceQA corpus repo (shuzi, 465★, Feng et al. ASRU 2015): the first open QA corpus in the insurance domain
e.summary_hk: 保險 QA 語料原始倉庫（shuzi，465★，Feng 等 ASRU 2015）：保險領域首個開放 QA 語料
e.body_en:
The InsuranceQA Corpus (shuzi/insuranceQA, 465★) is the original corpus repository of the paper "Applying Deep Learning to Answer Selection" (Feng / Bing Xiang et al., ASRU 2015): questions and answers collected from Insurance Library — the first open QA corpus in the insurance domain (12,888 training / 2,000 test questions, each with 500 candidate answers), the classic benchmark of answer-selection research. For RIAA: the benchmark source of insurance QA research — the origin of the data in [[insuranceqa-corpus]] (the Chinese 1065★ version) and [[insurance-qa-en]] (English mirror); with [[insqabench]] (Chinese insurance QA evaluation) and [[qa-deep-learning]] (the CNN paper code) it marks the starting point of insurance NLP.

**Related**: a HuggingFace repackaging of this corpus is recorded in dataset form at [[insurance-qa-en]].
e.body_hk:
InsuranceQA Corpus（shuzi/insuranceQA，465★）是論文《Applying Deep Learning to Answer Selection》（Feng/Bing Xiang 等，ASRU 2015）發佈的原始語料倉庫：從 Insurance Library 收集的問題與答案——保險領域首個開放的 QA 語料（12,888 訓練/2,000 測試題，每題 500 個候選答案），答案選擇（answer selection）研究的經典基準。對 RIAA：保險 QA 研究的基準源頭——池中 [[insuranceqa-corpus]]（中文版 1065★）與 [[insurance-qa-en]]（英文鏡像）的數據源；配 [[insqabench]]（中文保險 QA 評測）與 [[qa-deep-learning]]（CNN 論文程式碼）理解保險 NLP 起點。

**相關**：本語料的 HuggingFace 再包裝（數據集形態）見 [[insurance-qa-en]]。
